scope: Complete existing requests, sources, resources and parameter objects are preserved. Whole existing catalogs are referenced instead of copying them again. Only 14 pre-request verified launch descriptions and five separate H/QR array-directory descriptions are proposed for exact Git restoration; no scientific state or result payload is retired.

retention29.scope: All original61/73/95 requests, inputs, source versions and known unavailable-parent boundaries remain whole; this retention does not retire parent91 or its input-binding.

native_source_pair_definition: Each native run lists all ordered pairs by zero-based index into native_source_pairs. This preserves every name and original SHA in both current_sources and frozen_sources; no source alias is inferred from an equal filename.
